svg.title: Set B and the faster set in the same trials
svg.desc: In the 35 to 38 degrees Celsius setpoint trial, the faster set settles in 6.7 seconds instead of 8.6 seconds, with the heater command rising to 98.41 percent instead of 95.06 percent. In the 30 kilowatt load trial, both sets dip to about 33.6 degrees Celsius.
svg.text: Set B and the faster set in the same trials
Control Studio validation trials · setpoint 35 → 38 °C, and 30 kW load at 35 °C · set B from Lesson 27 · numbers answer the predictions
New set settles in 6.7 s; set B in 8.6 s
New set: up to 98.41 %; set B: 95.06 %
